text_block_list.text:
On my way home from a meeting, I stopped by
a lively street, where a festival fair was being held.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Up next is the main event sponsored by NAU!
It's a live talk show featuring two dirt umamusume you definitely need to keep your eyes on!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna crush every single one of 'em in the dirt scene!
I'm Espoir City!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Please come visit Funabashi.
I am Furioso.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Ohh! Pushing Funabashi right away, what an expert!"
"Espo-chan is so cute~♡"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh!?
Did you just call me cute... Don't you dare look down on meee!!
Thinking this might serve as good reference for <chrname> going forward——

text_block_list.name: Rude Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Come on, the guests are dirt umamusume~?
I only know turf girls, man~!

text_block_list.name: Rude Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, where even is Funabashi anyway?
Gahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...My hometown's Funabashi Racecourse is located in northwestern Chiba Prefecture, facing Tokyo Bay.

text_block_list.name: Rude Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, talk about serious.
Zero sense of humor. How boring.

...All sorts of crowds come to festivals.
Even so, the behavior of these rowdy young guys had crossed the line.
(SLAM——!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ——The only boring thing here is you.

text_block_list.name: Rude Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? W-Wait...? 
No way, weren't you just on that stage over——

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, say that again.
What the hell did you just mock? Who do you think you are talking like that?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: There ain't a single piece of pride here that you punks have the right to drag through the mud!!!!

text_block_list.name: Rude Spectator A & B
text_block_list.text:
Eep... Ah... Ah.
——W-W-We're so sorryyyy!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~ I'm beat.
Let's hurry up and go home.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ——Um.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for earlier.
That behavior infuriated me as well.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
However, doing things that way will only end up costing you someday.
A more peaceful approach would have——

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Shut up!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Against guys like that!?
Like hell I'm gonna let 'em run their mouths!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: With their trashy pride! Acting all high and mighty! Looking down on us!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Pointing fingers and laughing from inside the crowd...
Against pathetic bastards like them!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I swore to myself! I won't let anyone tarnish my pride even by a single millimeter!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You should get mad too! Don't let 'em slide!!
Funabashi is——your precious pride, isn't it!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! You've got some real fiery guts to say that, sis!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Wait. What!?
Hey, where'd you guys come from——

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
We came looking for tonight's stars!
The festival's far from over, you know~!
After the talk show, when Espoir City and the others reappeared, they were quickly surrounded by the crowd asking for autographs and handshakes one after another.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Hey, you too, big guy! Come over here! Come on, you wanna shake hands with the festival's star, don'tcha!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Hey, you too, miss! Come over here! Come on, you wanna shake hands with the festival's star, don'tcha!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Argh, stop pushing, stop pushing!
What is it!? You want a handshake too!?
Or did you wanna say somethin' to me, huh!?
choice_data_list: I watched your show the other day! That courage was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...What's with that? Man, there are so many weird adults around here.
Seeing that, wouldn't a normal person scold me?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ............Well, guess it doesn't feel bad, though!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh~~~!?
By that show the other day, you mean——

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Could it be... that pool diving one...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh? Haaah~~!?
Don't bring that topic up right now!!
